name: Neural NeRF Compression (Per-Scene, Encoder-Free)
definition: A method for compressing grid-based NeRF models (specifically TensoRF-VM) by optimizing latent codes directly for individual scenes without an encoder, using a lightweight decoder and a masked entropy model to minimize rate-distortion loss.
summary: Neural NeRF Compression optimizes latent codes directly per scene without an encoder, using a masked entropy model to minimize rate-distortion loss and reduce storage costs.
